translations.Un délégué peut gérer votre agenda, votr: A delegate can manage your calendar, mail or contacts with the permissions given below, receive your meeting requests and answer them on your behalf. These are the same settings as in Outlook (File → Account Settings → Delegate Access).

translations.Vos contacts Exchange sont copiés dans u: Your Exchange contacts are copied into an address book « Exchange — {email} » of Nextcloud Contacts: the Contacts app, the phones synced with Nextcloud and the other apps see them there. Exchange stays the reference: the copy is brought up to date every 6 hours, and changes made in the copy are replaced.
translations.Votre boîte aux lettres est presque plei: Your mailbox is almost full ({percent}%): empty the deleted items or archive messages, otherwise sending will be blocked.
translations.Vous n'avez pas accès à la boîte %s : de: You do not have access to the mailbox %s: ask its owner to make you a delegate in Outlook (at least for the inbox), or the Exchange administrator for the “Full Access” permission
translations.Vous n'avez pas le droit d'envoyer au no: You are not allowed to send as this mailbox: you need the “Send As” permission (Exchange administrator) or to be this person's delegate in Outlook (the message is then sent “on behalf of”)
translations.Vous n'avez pas le droit d'écrire dans c: You are not allowed to write to this folder
translations.Vous n'êtes pas délégué de cette personn: You are not this person's delegate in Exchange
translations.Vous ne pouvez pas ajouter d'événement d: You cannot add events to this calendar
translations.Vous ne pouvez pas ajouter de contact da: You cannot add contacts to this address book
translations.Vous ne pouvez pas répondre au nom de ce: You cannot reply on behalf of this person: their calendar is shared with you read-only
translations.Vous ne pouvez pas être votre propre dél: You cannot be your own delegate
translations.Vous serez prévenu des nouveaux messages: You will be notified of new messages as long as Nextcloud is open in a tab
translations.Vous trouverez l'adresse du serveur dans: You will find the server address in the OVH customer area (Hosted Exchange → General information, e.g. %1$s). A host name is enough: the EWS URL %2$s is completed automatically.
translations.Vous êtes délégué : seuls les dossiers q: You are a delegate: only the folders shared with you are shown
translations.Vous êtes l'organisateur de cette réunio: You are the organiser of this meeting
